name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.NonLattice.chain_noise_bias
title: Hamming GGH15 noise compounding: the path noise sum_i r_i^T E_i h_i has bias (1-2tau)^(sum_i wt(r_i) wt(h_i)) <= (1-2tau)^(L rho)
statement: Let E be L independent n_r x n_c matrices over F_2 with i.i.d. Bernoulli(tau) entries (flattened to a function on Fin L x Fin m x Fin n), r_i in F_2^m nonzero and h_i in F_2^n of weight at least rho. Then the bias of the bilinear noise sum_i r_i^T E_i h_i equals (1 - 2 tau)^(sum_i wt(r_i) wt(h_i)), and for 0 <= tau <= 1/2 this is at most (1 - 2 tau)^(L rho).
